title: Prime Big Deal Days 2026 is here: 180+ of the best deals to shop now
summary: From tech and toys to kitchen, beauty, and fall fashion, here are the top deals to shop during the 48-hour event, running through 11:59 p.m. PDT on Wednesday, Oct. 7.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- [Prime Big Deal Days 2026](https://www.aboutamazon.com/prime-big-deal-days) is underway. It runs 48 hours, from 12:01 a.m. PDT (3:01 a.m. EDT) on Tuesday, October 6, through 11:59 p.m. PDT on Wednesday, October 7 (2:59 a.m. EDT Thursday).


- Today's Big Deals drop three times daily, at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT (3 a.m., 11 a.m., and 4 p.m. EDT). Discounts reach up to 55% or more, most at Amazon's lowest price of the year so far.


- We're rounding up the best deals across tech, toys, kitchen, beauty, and fashion, and updating this list throughout both days.


---


Ready to kick off fall and holiday shopping? Prime Big Deal Days 2026 is officially here, giving Prime members 48 hours of deals across fashion, electronics, beauty, toys, home, and more—including everything you need for fall wardrobe refreshes, Halloween and game-day gatherings, and getting a head start on holiday gifting.


[8 Amazon AI features to help you find the best deals this Prime Big Deal Days](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-ai-shopping-tools)


Prime Big Deal Days 2026 starts on October 6, and these AI shopping tools can help you find, track, and score the best deals.


This year’s event, running through Wednesday, October 7, features deals at Amazon’s lowest prices of the year so far, with savings on top brands like LEGO, La Roche-Posay, and UGG. Today’s Big Deals are back with limited-time offers at up to 55% or more off, with new drops launching three times daily at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT.


We’ve rounded up some of the best deals available right now. We’ll keep updating this list throughout the event, so be sure to check back often.


All deals and availability are subject to change.
